arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=15))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {"main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    sd = root.find("main:sheetData", NS)

def cell_val(row_el, col_letter):
    for c in row_el.findall("main:c", NS):
        ref = c.get("r")
        if ref and ref.startswith(col_letter):
            v = c.find("main:v", NS)
            return v.text if v is not None else None
    return None

expenses = []
for row in sd.findall("main:row", NS):
    r = int(row.get("r"))
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        label = cell_val(row, "B")
        amt = cell_val(row, "C")
        expenses.append((r, label, amt))

total = sum(float(amt) for _, _, amt in expenses)
print("Expense items:")
for r, label, amt in expenses:
    print(f"  {label}: {amt}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES: {total:,.2f}")

income_rows = [r for r in sd.findall("main:row", NS) if 4 <= int(r.get("r")) <= 7]
income = sum(float(cell_val(r, "B")) for r in income_rows)
print(f"TOTAL INCOME (context): {income:,.2f}")
